Base.Name: Base
Base.Description: Goku's Base form, nothing special about it, just the good old Goku we know.

PSSJBlue.Name: Perfected Super Saiyan Blue
PSSJBlue.Description:
The Perfected version of Super Saiyan Blue, this transformation is slightly stronger then the regular one, but when comes to Ki Drain, it's way better and more stable then regular Super Saiyan Blue.

The Ki Drain it's low, and still has an immense power.

SSJBlue.Name: Super Saiyan Blue
SSJBlue.Description:
Essentially a Super Saiyan God but merged with the regular Super Saiyan, or also known as Super Saiyan God Super Saiyan, was obtained by Goku when he was training with Whis to master Ki Control, discovering the ability to use both transformations at once.

The Ki Drain it's medium, but it's power is worth it to use for raw strength.

SSJBlue.Name: Super Saiyan Blue
SSJBlue.Description: The Ki Drain it's medium, but it's power is worth it to use for raw strength.

Ultimate.Name: Mystic Gohan
Ultimate.Description:
AKA Ultimate Gohan, this transformation represents Gohan's alternative path among Saiyan transformations, bypassing the traditional Super Saiyan forms as a base for advanced power-ups.

This form has minimal Ki drain compared to Super Saiyan 2 and is significantly stronger as well.

PSSJBlue.Name: Super Saiyan Blue Evolution
PSSJBlue.Description:
The Perfected version of Super Saiyan Blue, this transformation is slightly stronger then the regular one, but when comes to Ki Drain, it's way better and more stable then regular Super Saiyan Blue.

The Ki Drain it's low, and still has an immense power.

SSJBlueEvolution.Name: Rage
SSJBlueEvolution.Description:
The direct evolution of Super Saiyan Blue, much more powerful, was obtained during Vegeta's Fight agains't Jiren on the Tournament of Power, after pushing through his limits several times.

This transformation can be extremly powerful, but also consumes a lot of Ki as a down side.

SSJBlue.Name: Super Saiyan Blue
SSJBlue.Description:
Just like Goku, Vegeta learned how to infuse the power of a regular Super Saiyan into the Divine Form of a Saiyan.

The Ki Drain it's medium, but it's power is worth it to use for raw strength.

BlackForm.Name: Black Frieza
BlackForm.Description: Frieza's black form, far beyond Golden Frieza.

FinalForm.Name: Final Form
FinalForm.Description: Frieza's Final Form (or so it was meant to be), beside it's name, this is actually Frieza's True Form, him in his natural state, but not at 100% of his power yet.

GoldenForm.Name: Golden Form
GoldenForm.Description:
An ironic tribute to Goku's Super Saiyan, Frieza unleashed such power by simply training for a couple months, being able to become stronger way faster than Goku or Vegeta.

This transformation has a medium Ki Drain amount, but taking in account it's power increase, it's very worth it.

FullPower.Name: Full Power
FullPower.Description:
The Full Power of Frieza was only used twice in the series, once in DBZ, and once in DBS, it sure gives a boost to Frieza's Power, but it also comes with a downside, it's lack of speed.

This Form has quite small Ki Drain, since Frieza has mastered his True Form, using his Full Power isn't as tiring as it used to be.

ThirdForm.Name: 3rd Form
ThirdForm.Description:
Maybe one of the strangest forms in Dragon Ball, Frieza's Third Form is once again another way to suppress his power, but just like the others, it was forgotten over time. This isn't his Final Form yet!

This transformation doesn't take any Ki from the user, since it's weaker than the Base Form.

SecondForm.Name: 2nd Form
SecondForm.Description:
The second form of Frieza, taller, with a pair of long horns in his head, it used to be a way to keep suppressing Frieza's power, but it isn't used anymore.

This transformation doesn't take any Ki from the user, since it's weaker than the Base Form.

FirstForm.Name: 1st Form
FirstForm.Description:
Frieza's weakest form, used to suppress his power in order to control it, although nowadays this form isn't needed anymore, since Frieza has mastered his Base Form.

This transformation doesn't take any Ki from the user, since it's weaker than the Base Form.

BeastGohan.Name: Beast Gohan
BeastGohan.Description:
Gohan's ultimate awakening against Cell Max, unleashing his Beast form with overwhelming power from his dormant potential.

This transformation drains a large amount of Ki while active.

SSJ1.Name: Super Saiyan 1
SSJ1.Description: Gogito transformation. 50x base power; standard DBPU ki, combat and aura.

SSJ2.Name: Super Saiyan 2
SSJ2.Description: Gogito transformation. 100x base power; standard DBPU ki, combat and aura.

SSJ3.Name: Super Saiyan 3
SSJ3.Description: Gogito transformation. 400x base power; standard DBPU ki, combat and aura.

SSJGod.Name: Super Saiyan God
SSJGod.Description: Gogito transformation. 20000x base power; standard DBPU ki, combat and aura.
